fails_if: resolve_scb_errata loads a classification on an undated [[errata.column]] (all_versions = true), whose binding has no period and so can only raise unsupported_classification_scope, published on the native variable that delivers the addition's anchor record (#1630)
note: The same entry with `versions` or `holdings_period` loads (scb-errata-column-undated-and-dated-holdings-load places the column both ways). An undated column may still be added without a classification.
